summary: The StudentPreInfControl is a web-based user control designed for managing student prerequisite information related to infection control, particularly focusing on the configuration of N95 mask sizes and fit test dates.
purpose: The purpose of the StudentPreInfControl is to facilitate the management and updating of student infection control prerequisites, including N95 mask size selection, fit test dates, and related infection control solutions. It ensures data integrity and compliance through controlled updates and validations.

fields.name: updPnlMain
fields.description: Main update panel for the control.

fields.name: fvmStdPrerequisite
fields.description: FormView for displaying and editing student prerequisites.

fields.name: ValidationSummary1
fields.description: Displays a summary of validation errors.

fields.name: uxDetail
fields.description: FormView for detailed student data entry and updates.

fields.name: dsStdPrerequisiteDetail
fields.description: DataSource for detailed student prerequisite information.

actors.name: UserSession
actors.role: Manages session data and user context.

workflows.name: Updating Student Data
steps: User selects N95 mask size and fit test date from dropdowns.
Data validation occurs; if validation fails, the update is canceled.
Upon successful validation, data is updated in the system.
After updating, the user is redirected to the Infection Control page.

business_rules: All updates must pass validation checks before being committed.
validations: Ensure form data is valid before processing updates.
N95 Mask Size and Fit Test Date must be selected from provided options.
conditions: If UserSession is null, data selection is canceled.
Screen is editable based on user role and permissions.
system_behavior: The control manages state through UserSession and handles user interactions via web forms.
exceptions: Null UserSession leads to operation cancellation during data selection.
